lastCompletedStory.title: Write the recorte of the claude -p prohibition and pin it with an evidence-fidelity oracle

nextStoryContext: US-008 closed GOTCHA L's seventh and last anchor point: scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md now carries a `**Recorte of the claude -p prohibition (ADR-0059, CAM-516):**` paragraph right after the 'Marking a patterns.md bullet resolved' paragraph (which still lists `claude -p forbidden` among durable invariants that must never be marked resolved, unchanged), stating the tmux worker path stays fully prohibited and `gship next --headless` is born exempt per the 2026-08-08 billing measurement in ADR-0059. The prose deliberately quotes ADR-0059's own Portuguese substrings verbatim in backticks (`consumo de API inalterado`, `apiKeySource none`, `sete dias`, `rodando no host e autenticando pelo diretorio de configuracao`) with English glosses alongside, so the new `test/docs/recorte-fidelity.test.ts` fidelity checker (CAM-439 evidence-fidelity species, kept local to the test file since it has exactly one caller) can cross-check by plain `String.includes` instead of a bilingual translation layer -- do not translate those quoted spans to pure English in a future edit, it would break the fidelity oracle. `src/commands/run-auth-preflight.ts`'s `checkClaudeAuth` JSDoc (was a blanket 'Must NOT use claude -p' comment) now explicitly says the prohibition is recortada and names `gship next --headless` as the only exempt path, while stating this particular auth-preflight probe itself stays a blanket ban regardless of dispatch mode. The five anchor test files (loop/worker-argv/review/plan-argv/docker-exec) were read-only this story, still green, no assertion touched. `scripts/file-size-budget.json` raised `src/commands/run-auth-preflight.ts` 141->145 with a dated CAM-516 US-008 `_ref` entry (the file grew from the JSDoc expansion). GOTCHA L (all seven anchors: five tests, the CLAUDE.md declaration, the run-auth-preflight.ts comment) is now fully addressed across US-008 and the prior CAM-516 stories; no anchor points remain open. `templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md` was diffed first (dual-copy convention) and confirmed to be a generic placeholder scaffold with no `claude -p` content of its own, so no template mirror edit or `embed-vendor` re-run was needed for this story. This is the last story mentioned by the current CAM-516 PRD context handed off from US-007; a future implementer should treat this as the end of the CAM-516 sequence unless prd.json still lists further stories.

No external library API surface introduced or re-touched.
